g.text: Creation event: exactly one per assignment.
Each event may affect zero or many assignments.
PK Primary key FK Foreign key
ACTIVE profile required; employee email may be null.
Role/assignment UUIDs are generated by PostgreSQL.
All five foreign keys use ON DELETE RESTRICT.
One current assignment per account + role.
Crow’s foot + circle: zero or many
Employee, manager and account IDs carried in event payloads are not additional foreign keys.
Owner ID / First / Last identify the employee.
Distinct Okta IDs remain separate accounts.
No environment is supplied or inferred.
